description: Lists the enrichment fields currently available in Nock, with the same catalogue, configured-provider filtering, input definitions, provider order and credit prices shown in the dashboard's Tools drawer. Each field id and its inputs are what a single-field enrichment takes. creditCost is the most per row found; a field with creditCostLabel has a price that depends on the source ("WhatsApp do decisor da empresa": 6 a 15 créditos por número achado, 6 for a number the business publishes, 15 for the partner's own mobile): quote that label and use creditCost for the maximum. Read-only and free. Every field fits any sheet. scope says how it runs: "person" once per person (companies without a person are skipped), "company" once per company, charged once and shown on every person of it.

query.description: Optional text filter over field names and descriptions.
